description:
Multiple tests merge a happy-path assertion with an empty-input-guard assertion in one #[tokio::test]:
- chat_smoke_tests.rs:571 chat_destroy_threads_ids_and_rejects_empty
- space_smoke_tests.rs:67 space_changes_passthrough_and_empty_state_rejected
- space_smoke_tests.rs:129 space_destroy_threads_ids_and_rejects_empty
- space_smoke_tests.rs:338 space_create_serializes_create_object_and_rejects_empty_name
- message_smoke_tests.rs:635 message_destroy_threads_ids_and_rejects_empty

When a combined test fails, the panic-text shows you which assertion broke but not which half conceptually. Splitting into two tests is cheap (a MockServer::start().await is sub-millisecond) and makes test failures self-describing. Convention: `{op}_serializes_*` and `{op}_rejects_empty_*` as separate tests.
title: Combined happy-path + empty-guard tests obscure which half fails
